questions.question: Which axis should be summed to obtain one return per environment from a time-major reward array?
options: Both axes before averaging by live transitions
questions.explanation: Summing over time leaves one scalar for each episode. Averaging these episode returns gives the finite-episode performance objective.
optionFeedback: Summing over time leaves one scalar for each episode. Averaging these episode returns gives the finite-episode performance objective.
Summing over environments merges different episodes. Keep one return per environment by reducing the time axis.
Reducing both axes gives one aggregate instead of per-environment returns. Inspect the intended output shape before computing a summary.
